propositions: An unchanged related ticket pinned under a supported historical fingerprint generation (post-330c/pre-2be7) is incorrectly classified as stale-pin-drift when the latest fingerprint algorithm differs, despite the current material matching the signed historical pin exactly.

pin_health.derive_health compares pins only against the latest fingerprint generation and lacks the compatibility predicate already implemented in attest._legacy_material_ok for own-ticket attestation validation.

The attestation wrapper must supply a narrowly scoped historical full-fingerprint compatibility check to classify mismatched latest fingerprints as current only when recomputation under a supported historical generation matches the signed pin.

Genuine material drift, malformed/missing pin classifications, and enforcement semantics must remain unchanged; only valid historical-generation pins should be reclassified from stale-pin-drift to current.
